title: Sequentially validate integrated client interactions
goal: Re-audit and finalize the already integrated client interactions in an isolated sequential checkpoint
acceptance_criteria: Complete integrated client behavior is re-audited against ARC-COMP-002
Completed state, smart range, filters, preferences, and feedback remain functional
No API or mobile scope drift

release_controls.rollback_plan: revert the local task commit before integration
release_controls.observation_metrics: validation results, changed paths, browser evidence, and governance review
release_controls.stop_conditions: scope drift, baseline mismatch, failing validation, or unresolved reviewer finding
